market_summary: The 13:30 UTC US macroeconomic release triggered widespread volatility expansions and aggressive two-sided wicks across all monitored asset classes during the London-NY Overlap session. While initial knee-jerk spikes drove prices through local VWAP and ATR channel boundaries on US100, BTCUSD, and FX pairs, Cumulative Delta (CVD) failed to confirm the rallies, showing neutral or outright bearish divergence. Gold and Silver both witnessed sharp mean-reversions back into their respective Points of Control (POC), while equities and crypto stalled outside upper ATR bands beneath major structural resistance. Given the heightened noise and absence of closed-bar RVOL > 2.0 breakout acceptance, disciplined capital preservation dictates a full HOLD stance across the board until market structure stabilizes.

GEX is null. Conflicting order flow and price sitting on POC dictate HOLD.
